انتحرنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرْنَا (intaḥarnā) /in.ta.ħar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اُنْتُحِرْنَا (untuḥirnā) /un.tu.ħir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
